title: Fix `Input.vibrate_handheld` on Android.

labels.name: cherrypick:4.4
labels.description: Considered for cherry-picking into a future 4.4.x release

body:
Fixes #103496

Catched the crash via `try / catch`.

```kotlin
			try {
                                 ....
                                 vibratorService.vibrate( .... )
                                 ....
			} catch (e: SecurityException) {
				Log.w(TAG, e)
			}

```
